surface_name: Streaming, notFound and redirect status codes
title: notFound() returns HTTP 200 instead of 404 when called inside a Suspense boundary or under loading.tsx
symptoms: curl -I on a missing record returns 200 OK while the page shows the not-found UI
redirect() inside a streamed component does not send a 307 or 308 Location header
cause: Once a Suspense fallback or loading.tsx renders, the response headers and status are already flushed. A later notFound() or redirect() can only patch the streamed HTML, not the status line.
fix: Call notFound() and redirect() before any await that sits under Suspense, or move the check into proxy or next.config redirects. With cacheComponents, set instant = false on the segment so it blocks instead of streaming a shell.
affected: Next.js App Router 13.4 to 16.4, any route with loading.tsx or a Suspense boundary above the check
